# まで vs までに — extent vs deadline

**[まで (extent)](<../grammar/made.md#extent> "As far as or up to an extent.")**
:   A continuing state or action runs up to the limit: 5時まで働く — working the whole time until 5. Also spatial: 駅まで歩く。Continuous, not a deadline.

**[までに](<../grammar/made-ni.md> "By a deadline; the action must occur no later than that time")**
:   The action completes no later than the deadline: 5時までに帰る — done by 5, any time before. If the verb continues rather than completes, you want まで.
